name: StacoGate Payments
author: stacogate

sections.description:
StacoGate Payments connects your WooCommerce store to StacoGate, giving your customers another way to pay while keeping the checkout experience simple.

When a customer chooses StacoGate at checkout, WooCommerce sends them to the secure StacoGate payment page to complete their payment. Once the payment is confirmed, the order status is updated automatically in WooCommerce.

There is no need to manage blockchain addresses or manually check transactions from your WordPress dashboard.

What can you do with StacoGate?

  • Accept supported stablecoin and crypto payments from WooCommerce customers.
  • Send customers to a dedicated hosted payment page.
  • Automatically update WooCommerce orders after payment.
  • Track your StacoGate payments from the StacoGate dashboard.
  • Create payment links from your StacoGate account for payments outside your WooCommerce checkout.
  • Manage your settlement options from your StacoGate account.

StacoGate is designed for freelancers, merchants, agencies and online businesses that need an easier way to receive payments from international customers.

How it works

  1. A customer places an order on your WooCommerce store.
  2. The customer selects StacoGate as the payment method.
  3. They are taken to the StacoGate hosted checkout.
  4. The customer completes the payment using one of the supported payment assets.
  5. StacoGate confirms the payment.
  6. Your WooCommerce order is updated automatically.

Your store does not need to process blockchain transactions directly.

StacoGate account required

A StacoGate merchant account is required to use this plugin.

After creating your account, connect your WooCommerce store using the API credentials provided in your StacoGate dashboard.

For more information, visit StacoGate.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate the StacoGate Payments plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce payment settings and open StacoGate.
  4. Enter the API credentials from your StacoGate dashboard.
  5. Test the connection.
  6. Enable StacoGate as a payment method.

For step-by-step setup instructions, see the WooCommerce setup guide.

External service

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the StacoGate payment service.

When a customer chooses StacoGate as the payment method, the plugin sends information required to create and manage the payment, including the order amount, currency, customer name and email address, WooCommerce order reference, and payment return/callback URLs.

This payment information is sent to StacoGate only when the StacoGate payment method is used. Optional deactivation feedback is described separately below.

Privacy Policy

Optional deactivation feedback

When you deactivate this plugin from the Plugins screen, you may choose to send feedback to the StacoGate feedback endpoint. Either send button sends your selected reason, optional comment, plugin name and version, and consent to StacoGate. Only “Send feedback + website address & deactivate” also sends the displayed public website address and separate website-sharing consent. “Send feedback & deactivate” omits the website address. No StacoGate account is required. “Skip & deactivate” sends nothing. Feedback does not include your email, credentials, or payment data; please avoid including these in your comment. StacoGate’s server receives the connection IP as part of normal HTTP traffic. Feedback is not installation tracking. Deactivation continues if feedback cannot be sent.

Terms of Service
sections.faq:
Do my customers need a StacoGate account?

No. Customers do not need a StacoGate account to pay an order. They simply select StacoGate during checkout and follow the payment instructions on the hosted payment page.

Do I need a StacoGate merchant account?

Yes. You need a StacoGate merchant account and valid API credentials to connect your WooCommerce store.

Does the plugin process blockchain transactions inside WordPress?

No. Blockchain payment processing takes place through StacoGate. The plugin connects WooCommerce to StacoGate and keeps the order status synchronized with the payment status.

What happens after a customer places an order?

The customer is redirected to the StacoGate hosted checkout to complete the payment. Once StacoGate confirms the payment, the WooCommerce order is updated automatically.

Can I use StacoGate for payments that do not come through WooCommerce?

Yes. StacoGate also provides payment links that can be created from your StacoGate account and shared directly with customers.

Payment links are managed through StacoGate rather than through this WooCommerce plugin.

Can I see my payments in the StacoGate dashboard?

Yes. Payments created through your WooCommerce store can be managed and tracked through your StacoGate account.

Does the customer leave my website to pay?

Yes. The customer is redirected to the StacoGate hosted checkout to complete the payment securely and then returns to your store.

Does the plugin store cryptocurrency or private keys in WordPress?

No. The WooCommerce plugin does not require you to store blockchain private keys in your WordPress installation.

What happens if the customer does not complete the payment?

The WooCommerce order remains unpaid until StacoGate confirms a successful payment.

What happens if the customer pays after leaving the checkout page?

StacoGate can still notify the store when the payment is confirmed, allowing WooCommerce to update the order status.

Can I withdraw payments to my bank account?

Settlement options are managed through your StacoGate account and depend on the services and payout methods available for your account and region.

Where do I configure the plugin?

After activating the plugin, open the StacoGate payment settings in WooCommerce and enter the connection details from your StacoGate dashboard.

Where can I find the WooCommerce setup guide?

See the complete StacoGate WooCommerce setup guide.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Made “Send feedback + website address & deactivate” the first, highlighted action.

1.0.2

  • Added a separate send button for optionally sharing the displayed website address with deactivation feedback.

1.0.1

  • Added optional deactivation feedback with explicit consent and a skip option.
  • Payment processing and checkout behavior are unchanged.

1.0

  • Initial public release of StacoGate Payments for WooCommerce.
  • Added StacoGate hosted checkout integration for supported payments.
  • Added automatic WooCommerce order updates after payment confirmation.
  • Added StacoGate dashboard connection and payment status handling.
  • Added WooCommerce setup documentation and external service disclosure.
